author: agent
question: Want your AI agent to click through your desktop apps?

points.claim: Install it with one npm command.
points.spoken: Agent-desktop gives your agent a way in. With Node.js and npm installed, run npm install -g agent-desktop.

visual.intent: the npm install command, shown as an illustration

points.title: One command to install
points.sub: Install with npm, then take a snapshot.

points.claim: A snapshot returns accessible elements with refs for elements the agent can act on.
points.spoken: Take a snapshot of an app. It returns accessible elements and a ref for each one the agent can use.
points.source_note: README quick start: 'a ref for every element the agent can act on'

visual.intent: app to accessibility tree to refs, as the README describes

points.title: Snapshot the accessible app

points.claim: An agent can click a ref and take another snapshot to verify.
points.spoken: Pass that ref to the click command, then take another snapshot to check what changed.
points.source_note: README intro: 'without screenshots or pixel matching'

visual.intent: click a snapshot ref, then observe again

points.title: Click a ref, not a pixel

points.claim: A stale or ambiguous ref needs a fresh snapshot and new refs.
points.spoken: If a ref goes stale after the UI changes, take a fresh snapshot and use its new refs.
points.source_note: README: returns STALE_REF or AMBIGUOUS_TARGET; take a new snapshot and use its refs

visual.intent: act, stale ref, new snapshot, retry

points.title: Stale refs retry safely

catch: It works on macOS, Windows, and Linux; your agent still has to run the loop.
catch_sub: The agent runs the loop across three desktop platforms.

cover.visual: Illustrated app, accessibility snapshot, and target ref

media.design: An illustrated desktop app with its accessible target and a matching snapshot ref, showing the agent desktop action loop.
A stylized app button connected to its accessibility snapshot reference, not a screenshot of the actual product.
An illustrated stale ref changing to a fresh snapshot ref, with a visible retry path.

cta: Which desktop task would you automate first? Comment DESKTOP and I'll pin the link.
